messages:
Rowan (People Ops): Quick note  publishing a small handbook patch tomorrow to add the voluntary benefits opt-in window and clarify manager responsibilities. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/patches/vol-benefits
Ivy (Benefits): Opt-in window = 30 days from hire date, and an annual open enrollment in Nov. Adding a short FAQ for reimbursements.
Sam K (HR Ops): Managers will need to confirm their teams got the opt-in email. Can we centralize ack collection somewhere?
Rowan (People Ops): Yes  manager ack sheet: https://sheets.goo.gl/rdw-vol-benef-acks. Please mark "confirmed" after you share the email and confirm team has seen it. Deadline = 2 weeks after publish.
Lena (EMEA Partner): For UK/IE we need to ensure the opt-in wording complies with automatic enrollment rules — Legal, any quick check?
LegalBot: Automated note: for DE/FR/UK please include the local statutory reference line. I added comments to the draft under section 4.1.
Ivy (Benefits): I'll add three bullets to the FAQ (eligible dependents, carryover, tax treatment) and paste into the doc this afternoon.
Sam K (HR Ops): Scheduling: one 20-min manager drop-in next Wed 0900 UTC and a recording for catch-ups. Invites out in 5. Manager checklist in sheet header.
Rowan (People Ops): Hiring ops heads  quick ask: grep active JDs for "benefits" or "opt-in". If they call out specific windows or reimbursement caps, tag @Sam K so we can update before posting.
Lena (EMEA Partner): I'll sweep EMEA reqs and tag any owners. Found 1 posting that says "enrollment within 14 days"  tagging @Sam K now.
Ivy (Benefits): Note for payroll: once ack CSV is uploaded to HRIS, payroll needs 5 business days to process opt-ins. Adding that note to sheet.
LegalBot: Auto-update: manager ack tracker created. Current counts: 5/30 confirmed, 1 session scheduled. Reminders auto-send 72h before deadline.
Rowan (People Ops): Thanks team  final deadline for manager confirms: two weeks after publish at 17:00 UTC. I'll post summary in #general 24h before publish. :sparkles:
